senses.gloss:
जुगुप्सनम्,
जुगुप्सा 
__1 Censure, reproach. 
__2 Dislike, aversion, disgust, abhorrence. 
__3 (In Rhet.) Disgust considered as the feeling which gives rise to the Bībhatsa sentiment, thus defined:--दोषेक्षणादिभिर्गर्हा जुगुप्सा विषयोद्भवा [[S. D. 207.]]
A disgusting or horrible deed; जुगुप्सितं धर्मकृतेऽनुशासतः [[Bhāg. 1. 5. 15.]] कर्मजुगुप्सितेन ibid 1. 7. 42.
